question: Which of the following Articles about fundamental duties is related to the respect of the National Anthem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51A (a)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 51A (a):-**

 
 
• It outlines the fundamental duty of every citizen to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem.
